rangeMap.note: World view native range Philippines endemic across major and some smaller islands. Only PHL highlighted, not all national territory occupied; rare vagrant HK and Taiwan records excluded from native range map. No exact occurrence or habitat polygons.

sources.use: Full page read: 48-58cm orange-buff eyebrow face/upper neck, black crown/eye stripe, dull brown fringed upperparts paler below, grey bill dark centre/nail; Philippines endemic, HK/Taiwan vagrant records; VU decreasing due hunting/wetland loss.
Substantive page read: yellow-tipped dark bill, pale head with dark crown/eye stripe, darkening rear body, white tertial edges, blue-green speculum with white borders.
Search result identification read: female mottled brown and orange-black bill, white-bordered blue speculum.
Authoritative runtime scores; missing values remain blank; vEst flag means body length used for visibility is estimated.
